Note B of the KPMG-examined August 31, 2026 report records $1,129,357,410 in demand-deposit cash and cash equivalents and $3,066,358,657 in government money-market fund shares (CUSIP 31607A703), totaling $4,195,716,067. The separate BitGo Bank & Trust account balance is zero.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The August report establishes segregated accounts titled to BitGo for USD1 holders at regulated U.S. financial institutions. It does not identify individual deposit banks or the institution holding the fund shares, or establish bankruptcy-remoteness and rehypothecation treatment. Holders have contractual redemption rights rather than a security interest or direct property interest in specific reserve assets.
